---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a focused improvement to openEfficiency
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## Task or problem

What are you trying to accomplish in PowerPoint? Describe your current workaround.

## Expected behavior

Explain the intended result, selection requirements and any useful example. Note your installed openEfficiency version if the request changes an existing command.

## Alternatives and examples

Screenshots or mockups are welcome. Use only material you may share publicly and remove confidential information. A request does not imply a release commitment.
